description: Find the ISO 8601 week of a date. Send a date (YYYY-MM-DD, 1990 to 2100). Get back the ISO week-year (which can differ from the calendar year in the last and first days of a year), the week number 1 to 53, the ISO weekday (1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday), the weekday name, the written form such as 2026-W47-5, the first day (Monday) and last day (Sunday) of that week, and whether that ISO year has 52 or 53 weeks. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/iso-week-number). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

date.description: The date to place in the ISO week calendar, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person).
